units.leftText: Therefore let’s also, seeing we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily entangles us, and let’s run with perseverance the race that is set before us,
units.rightText: Therefore let us also, seeing we are compassed about with so great a cloud of witnesses, lay aside every weight, and the sin which doth so easily beset us, and let us run with patience the race that is set before us,

units.leftText: looking to Jesus, the author and perfecter of faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising its shame, and has sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.
units.rightText: looking unto Jesus the author and perfecter of our faith, who for the joy that was set before him endured the cross, despising shame, and hath sat down at the right hand of the throne of God.

units.leftText: For consider him who has endured such contradiction of sinners against himself, that you don’t grow weary, fainting in your souls.
units.rightText: For consider him that hath endured such gainsaying of sinners against himself, that ye wax not weary, fainting in your souls.

units.leftText: You have not yet resisted to blood, striving against sin.
units.rightText: Ye have not yet resisted unto blood, striving against sin:

units.leftText: You have forgotten the exhortation which reasons with you as with children,
units.rightText: and ye have forgotten the exhortation which reasoneth with you as with sons,

units.leftText: for whom the Lord loves, he disciplines,
units.rightText: For whom the Lord loveth he chasteneth,

units.leftText: It is for discipline that you endure. God deals with you as with children, for what son is there whom his father doesn’t discipline?
units.rightText: It is for chastening that ye endure; God dealeth with you as with sons; for what son is there whom his father chasteneth not?

units.leftText: But if you are without discipline, of which all have been made partakers, then you are illegitimate, and not children.
units.rightText: But if ye are without chastening, whereof all have been made partakers, then are ye bastards, and not sons.

units.leftText: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we paid them respect. Shall we not much rather be in subjection to the Father of spirits and live?
units.rightText: Furthermore, we had the fathers of our flesh to chasten us, and we gave them reverence: shall we not much rather be in subjection unto the Father of spirits, and live?

units.leftText: For they indeed for a few days disciplined us as seemed good to them, but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.
units.rightText: For they indeed for a few days chastened us as seemed good to them; but he for our profit, that we may be partakers of his holiness.

units.leftText: All chastening seems for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yields the peaceful fruit of righteousness to those who have been trained by it.
units.rightText: All chastening seemeth for the present to be not joyous but grievous; yet afterward it yieldeth peaceable fruit unto them that have been exercised thereby, even the fruit of righteousness.

units.leftText: Therefore lift up the hands that hang down and the feeble knees,
units.rightText: Wherefore lift up the hands that hang down, and the palsied knees;

units.leftText: and make straight paths for your feet, so what is lame may not be dislocated, but rather be healed.
units.rightText: and make straight paths for your feet, that that which is lame be not turned out of the way, but rather be healed.

units.leftText: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man will see the Lord,
units.rightText: Follow after peace with all men, and the sanctification without which no man shall see the Lord:

units.leftText: looking carefully lest there be any man who falls short of the grace of God, lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you and many be defiled by it,
units.rightText: looking carefully lest there be any man that falleth short of the grace of God; lest any root of bitterness springing up trouble you, and thereby the many be defiled;

units.leftText: lest there be any sexually immoral person or profane person, like Esau, who sold his birthright for one meal.
units.rightText: lest there be any fornicator, or profane person, as Esau, who for one mess of meat sold his own birthright.

units.leftText: For you know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected, for he found no place for a change of mind though he sought it diligently with tears.
units.rightText: For ye know that even when he afterward desired to inherit the blessing, he was rejected; for he found no place for a change of mind in his father, though he sought it diligently with tears.

units.leftText: For you have not come to a mountain that might be touched and that burned with fire, and to blackness, darkness, storm,
units.rightText: For ye are not come unto a mount that might be touched, and that burned with fire, and unto blackness, and darkness, and tempest,

units.leftText: the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which those who heard it begged that not one more word should be spoken to them,
units.rightText: and the sound of a trumpet, and the voice of words; which voice they that heard entreated that no word more should be spoken unto them;

units.leftText: for they could not stand that which was commanded, “If even an animal touches the mountain, it shall be stoned”.
units.rightText: for they could not endure that which was enjoined, If even a beast touch the mountain, it shall be stoned;
leftNotes: 12:20 TR adds “or shot with an arrow”

units.leftText: So fearful was the appearance that Moses said, “I am terrified and trembling.”
units.rightText: and so fearful was the appearance, that Moses said, I exceedingly fear and quake:

units.leftText: But you have come to Mount Zion and to the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable multitudes of angels,
units.rightText: but ye are come unto mount Zion, and unto the city of the living God, the heavenly Jerusalem, and to innumerable hosts of angels,

units.leftText: to the festal gathering and assembly of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, to God the Judge of all, to the spirits of just men made perfect,
units.rightText: to the general assembly and church of the firstborn who are enrolled in heaven, and to God the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,

units.leftText: to Jesus, the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaks better than that of Abel.
units.rightText: and to Jesus the mediator of a new covenant, and to the blood of sprinkling that speaketh better than that of Abel.

units.leftText: See that you don’t refuse him who speaks. For if they didn’t escape when they refused him who warned on the earth, how much more will we not escape who turn away from him who warns from heaven,
units.rightText: See that ye refuse not him that speaketh. For if they escaped not when they refused him that warned them on earth, much more shall not we escape who turn away from him that warneth from heaven:

units.leftText: whose voice shook the earth then, but now he has promised, saying, “Yet once more I will shake not only the earth, but also the heavens.”
units.rightText: whose voice then shook the earth: but now he hath promised, saying, Yet once more will I make to tremble not the earth only, but also the heaven.

units.leftText: This phrase, “Yet once more” signifies the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.
units.rightText: And this word, Yet once more, signifieth the removing of those things that are shaken, as of things that have been made, that those things which are not shaken may remain.

units.leftText: Therefore, receiving a Kingdom that can’t be shaken, let’s have grace, through which we serve God acceptably, with reverence and awe,
units.rightText: Wherefore, receiving a kingdom that cannot be shaken, let us have grace, whereby we may offer service well-pleasing to God with reverence and awe:

units.leftText: for our God is a consuming fire.
units.rightText: for our God is a consuming fire.

units.leftText: Let brotherly love continue.
units.rightText: Let love of the brethren continue.

units.leftText: Don’t forget to show hospitality to strangers, for in doing so, some have entertained angels without knowing it.
units.rightText: Forget not to show love unto strangers: for thereby some have entertained angels unawares.

units.leftText: Remember those who are in bonds, as bound with them, and those who are ill-treated, since you are also in the body.
units.rightText: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; them that are ill-treated, as being yourselves also in the body.

units.leftText: Let marriage be held in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled; but God will judge the sexually immoral and adulterers.
units.rightText: Let marriage be had in honor among all, and let the bed be undefiled: for fornicators and adulterers God will judge.

units.leftText: Be free from the love of money, content with such things as you have, for he has said, “I will in no way leave you, neither will I in any way forsake you.”
units.rightText: Be ye free from the love of money; content with such things as ye have: for himself hath said, I will in no wise fail thee, neither will I in any wise forsake thee.

units.leftText: So that with good courage we say,
units.rightText: So that with good courage we say,

units.leftText: Remember your leaders, men who spoke to you the word of God, and considering the results of their conduct, imitate their faith.
units.rightText: Remember them that had the rule over you, men that spake unto you the word of God; and considering the issue of their life, imitate their faith.

units.leftText: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday, today, and forever.
units.rightText: Jesus Christ is the same yesterday and to-day, yea and for ever.

units.leftText: Don’t be carried away by various and strange teachings, for it is good that the heart be established by grace, not by foods, through which those who were so occupied were not benefited.
units.rightText: Be not carried away by divers and strange teachings: for it is good that the heart be established by grace; not by meats, wherein they that occupied themselves were not profited.

units.leftText: We have an altar from which those who serve the holy tabernacle have no right to eat.
units.rightText: We have an altar, whereof they have no right to eat that serve the tabernacle.

units.leftText: For the bodies of those animals, whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned outside of the camp.
units.rightText: For the bodies of those beasts whose blood is brought into the holy place by the high priest as an offering for sin, are burned without the camp.

units.leftText: Therefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered outside of the gate.
units.rightText: Wherefore Jesus also, that he might sanctify the people through his own blood, suffered without the gate.

units.leftText: Let’s therefore go out to him outside of the camp, bearing his reproach.
units.rightText: Let us therefore go forth unto him without the camp, bearing his reproach.

units.leftText: For we don’t have here an enduring city, but we seek that which is to come.
units.rightText: For we have not here an abiding city, but we seek after the city which is to come.

units.leftText: Through him, then, let’s offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which proclaim allegiance to his name.
units.rightText: Through him then let us offer up a sacrifice of praise to God continually, that is, the fruit of lips which make confession to his name.

units.leftText: But don’t forget to be doing good and sharing, for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.
units.rightText: But to do good and to communicate forget not: for with such sacrifices God is well pleased.

units.leftText: Obey your leaders and submit to them, for they watch on behalf of your souls, as those who will give account, that they may do this with joy and not with groaning, for that would be unprofitable for you.
units.rightText: Obey them that have the rule over you, and submit to them: for they watch in behalf of your souls, as they that shall give account; that they may do this with joy, and not with grief: for this were unprofitable for you.

units.leftText: Pray for us, for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.
units.rightText: Pray for us: for we are persuaded that we have a good conscience, desiring to live honorably in all things.

units.leftText: I strongly urge you to do this, that I may be restored to you sooner.
units.rightText: And I exhort you the more exceedingly to do this, that I may be restored to you the sooner.

units.leftText: Now may the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, our Lord Jesus,
units.rightText: Now the God of peace, who brought again from the dead the great shepherd of the sheep with the blood of an eternal covenant, even our Lord Jesus,

units.leftText: make you complete in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is well pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever and ever. Amen.
units.rightText: make you perfect in every good thing to do his will, working in us that which is well-pleasing in his sight, through Jesus Christ; to whom be the glory for ever and ever. Amen.

units.leftText: But I exhort you, brothers, endure the word of exhortation, for I have written to you in few words.
units.rightText: But I exhort you, brethren, bear with the word of exhortation: for I have written unto you in few words.

units.leftText: Know that our brother Timothy has been freed, with whom, if he comes shortly, I will see you.
units.rightText: Know ye that our brother Timothy hath been set at liberty; with whom, if he come shortly, I will see you.

units.leftText: Greet all of your leaders and all the saints. The Italians greet you.
units.rightText: Salute all them that have the rule over you, and all the saints. They of Italy salute you.

units.leftText: Grace be with you all. Amen.
units.rightText: Grace be with you all. Amen.
